affected_system: urban drainage, stormwater, and flood-response system
alternatives: fund distributed green infrastructure in overloaded catchments
optimize a mixed structural and nature-based portfolio
assumptions: Rainfall, terrain, drainage, and complaint records use explicit spatial and temporal supports.
Hydraulic capacities and intervention effects remain measured inputs or labeled assumptions.
All alternatives, capacities, costs, effects, thresholds, and failure scenarios are proposed until bound to evidence.

constraints.description: The selected portfolio must fit capital, maintenance, land, and delivery-year budgets.
Every released metric must retain evidence type, source lineage, geography, time, assumptions, and uncertainty.
No analytical output may bypass lawful authority, accountable human review, or an applicable appeal process.

decision_cadence: recompiled at each planning cycle and after material evidence change
decision_owner: stormwater utility director and emergency-management lead
decision_question: Which asset renewals and runoff-reduction projects best reduce expected disruption under the capital ceiling?

independence_key.binding_constraint: The selected portfolio must fit capital, maintenance, land, and delivery-year budgets.
independence_key.evidence_gate: Candidate costs, hydraulic benefits, maintenance loads, dependencies, and delivery capacity are independently reviewed.
independence_key.intervention_mechanism: risk-adjusted asset and green-infrastructure portfolio optimization

intended_claim: A versioned prioritize design for comparing declared alternatives affecting stormwater capital-renewal portfolio, conditional on its evidence gate.
limitations: This library record has no city binding and therefore reports no local input, output, or recommendation.
Readiness describes explicit source and method gates; it does not certify implementation feasibility.
External domain, legal, community, security, and operational review remains outside this design artifact.

objectives.metric: distributional gap in expected annual service-disruption hours
decision claims with complete evidence lineage

prohibited_claims: Do not call modeled avoided disruption a realized financial saving.
Do not describe a design-only record as a city execution, deployment, adopted policy, or impact result.
Do not relabel proposed, estimated, simulated, optimized, or causal evidence as observed evidence.
Do not infer individual behavior, protected status, harm, or entitlement from aggregate records.

release_gate.failure_release: Release an explicit insufficient-evidence record naming missing sources, failed diagnostics, prohibited claims, and the next validation action.
release_gate.pass_condition: Candidate costs, hydraulic benefits, maintenance loads, dependencies, and delivery capacity are independently reviewed.

title: Prioritize drainage renewal and green-infrastructure projects
transportability_risks: Drainage standards, imperviousness, topography, tides, and maintenance regimes differ.
Complaint density may reflect reporting access rather than flood incidence.
